chart.reason.barTop: {total} categories is too many to read — showing the top {n}.
chart.reason.histogram: {n} values of {x} — {k} bins show how they are distributed.
chart.reason.line: {x} is a time axis with {n} points — a line shows the trend.
chart.reason.lineBy: {x} is a time axis with {n} points; one line per {by} ({k} series).
chart.reason.map: {lat} / {lon} look like coordinates — plot them on a map.
chart.reason.pie: Only {n} categories — small enough to compare as slices.
chart.reason.pieSum: {n} parts adding up to {total} — a whole split into shares.
chart.reason.radar: {k} measures for {n} items — compare their profiles.
chart.reason.scatter: Two numeric columns — see how {y} relates to {x}.
chart.reason.stackedBar: {k} measures in the same unit — stacking shows each category’s total and its parts.
chart.reason.stackedBarMixed: {k} measures stacked — their scales differ, so totals may mislead.
chart.reason.summary: No category or time column — comparing column averages.
